study.name: iot4cows
study.description: Capacity of a single-gateway LoRaWAN network for collar-mounted cattle monitoring over an 88.54 ha grazing area.
study.path_loss_source: Field fit over 1,229 aggregated RSSI points, 30 m to 2.21 km, IoT4Cows deployment

provenance.description: MULTI at the 1 and 3 dB same-SF thresholds under both receiver rules, so that the margin's gain over MULTI can be read at those thresholds against the ADR rows of `receiver` and `inter_sf_threshold` (ROADMAP item 17). No rejection table: at this site MULTI puts every node on SF7, where the table has nothing to act on.
